XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: "Low AdBlue level" error that is not resolved by filling the tank
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0607-51 | P14A3-96 | ADBLUE | DOSING MODULE | QUALITY SENSOR | LEVEL ANOMALY | INJECTOR | TANK | QUANTITY | FAP | DPF | PARTICULATE | ANTI-PARTICULATE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: All vehicles

  • System: Pollutant emission reduction

  • Device: AdBlue system

  • Fault: The display indicates a low AdBlue level error that is not resolved by filling the tank

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: The problem stems from a malfunction of the AdBlue dosing module or level sensor. Even with a full tank, the system does not recognise the correct level, incorrectly indicating the need to refill AdBlue

• Action: Check that the AdBlue tank and injector are working correctly and, if necessary, replace them

  • Procedure:
    • Check the AdBlue level and top up if necessary
    • Clean the AdBlue injector and check that it is working correctly
    • If the injector is found to be clean but the fluid is not under pressure, replace the AdBlue tank (including the dosing module)
      Following replacement of the tank, fault code “P0607-51 – No programming” will appear; this indicates that the control unit must be reprogrammed.
  • Note: If, once the adjustment is complete, the error “P14A3-96 AdBlue/DEF quality sensor – Internal fault” is displayed, this means that the module in the tank is not fully compatible with the one previously installed. In this case, the new module must be reprogrammed using diagnostic equipment
